overview: This table describes each story chapter, including its displayed number and name, artwork, music, videos, voices, DLC access, and playable story missions.
description: Story chapter catalogue: 1-based ordering, localized title and presentation assets, DLC progress-flag unlock, chapter BGM/background-movie/voice routing, and the ordered demo lists used for progress and resume.

ID.simple: The unique name the game uses for this chapter. It links the chapter to its progress, music, voices, and story missions.
ID.technical: FName row key in StoryChapterDataTables (DTM +0x8B0), loaded from the single StoryChapterDataTable primary asset. Consumers use it to re-find the chapter row before reading the first UserProgressFlag, as the key of transient BGM/voice/release/movie maps, and as the result of index- and demo-to-chapter reverse lookups. The nine exported ids are unique and equal their row names.

ChapterIndex.simple: The chapter number shown in the story menus. Changing it changes which chapter the game finds when it asks for that number.
ChapterIndex.technical: int32 (row +0x10), default 0 in the constructor. Story_GetChapterIdByIndex scans table/row order for an exact match; Story_GetResumeDemo uses that index, Story_GetDemoChapterIndex returns this value (or -1 when no chapter lists the demo), and collection/chapter-select UIs insert it as the raw INDEX text parameter. Story_PickRoomPlacement uses the row with value 6 as its checkpoint. Exported values are 1..9; the field itself is an unclamped int32.

Id_StoryChapterTitle.simple: The chapter title players see in story menus and dialogs. Change this to change the title shown for the chapter.
Id_StoryChapterTitle.technical: FName (row +0x14). Chapter select, mission select, character-select mission info, script ShowTitle and system dialogs pass it directly as a text id (the system dialog supplies it as the MISSION_NAME parameter). The shop sale-item description returns it as the chapter name and substitutes ERROR only when no chapter row is found. All nine exported ids are keys in every exported StoryTextDataTable locale.

ThumbnailFileName.simple: The large chapter picture shown in the mission list. Change this to change the chapter's main artwork.
ThumbnailFileName.technical: FName (row +0x1C). UGameStoryMissionSelectWidget creates WidgetTexture primary-asset loaders from it when a chapter panel has no loaders; the panel resolves that loader into ThumbnailTexture, and SetupChapter installs that texture as the chapter image's ReplacementTexture material parameter. All exported rows set a non-None name.

SmallThumbnailFileName.simple: The small chapter picture shown on story chapter cards. DLC chapters use this same choice for their card artwork.
SmallThumbnailFileName.technical: FName (row +0x24). UGameStoryWidget creates WidgetTexture loaders for chapter-select and DLC chapter-select cards from it. The cards look up the loader by this key, place the loaded texture in the ReplacementTexture material parameter and set bIsMovie from the texture type. All exported rows use a non-None name ending in _576x324.

BackgroundMovieFileName.simple: The background movie played while the player views a DLC chapter menu. Chapters without one have no movie in this menu.
BackgroundMovieFileName.technical: FName. PrimeDlcBackground rebuilds ChapterMovieFiles as Chapter.Id -> "<value>.usm" for every non-None name; SetDlcBackgroundChapter switches only to chapters present in that map and the background widget passes the mapped string to SetMovieFile. Only CHAP_0008 (StoryTop_DLC01) and CHAP_0009 (StoryTop_DLC02) set it; the other seven exported chapters are None and get no map entry.

Id_Bgm.simple: The music played while the player browses this chapter in the story menu. Only DLC story chapters currently set their own music.
Id_Bgm.technical: FName. MainMenuStory::PreparePhase resolves non-None ids against every BgmDataTable, stores Bgm->Id in ChapterBgmIds keyed by Chapter.Id and seeds BgmResumes with start time 0; None chapters are skipped. PlayChapterBgm consumes those transient maps and returns when the chapter has no entry. Only CHAP_0008/CHAP_0009 set BGM_BATTLE_DLC_01/BGM_BATTLE_DLC_02; other main-menu-story modes use BGM_STORY.

UserProgressFlag.simple: The DLC unlock check for this chapter. It marks base story chapters, locks unowned DLC chapters, and points to the right store page.
UserProgressFlag.technical: TArray<int32> (row +0x40); all chapter consumers read only element 0, treating a missing row/empty array as -1. -1 means no DLC flag: MissionSelect_HasProgressFlag returns false, Story_GetChapterFirstUserProgressFlag returns -1, MainMenuStory_IsChapterLocked returns false, and Story_GetProgressFlagChapters_1302FC0 keeps those base-story rows. A set flag is decoded as word = uint32(flag) >> 2 and bit = uint32(flag) & 3 against UserProgressFlagWords[128]; word >= 128 is locked, otherwise an unset bit is locked. Exports use -1 for CHAP_0001..CHAP_0007, 6 for CHAP_0008 and 7 for CHAP_0009, decoding to word 1 / bits 2 and 3; the reconstructed entitlement map associates 6 with DLC07 and 7 with DLC08, and the DLC purchase flow matches the same value to a store page.

Id_PlayVoice_OnOpenMissionSelect.simple: The voice group connected to opening the mission list. It helps choose later lines, and DLC chapters use their own group.
Id_PlayVoice_OnOpenMissionSelect.technical: FName (row +0x50). BuildChapterVoicePicks resolves it to the OpenVoice row; RollChapterVoicePicks copies Id_Voice and Weights_VoiceLottery, removes None names and the same-index weights, and rolls a cumulative weighted PickIndex with the last entry as fallback. It does not play this row's PlayVoiceType directly; the index is reused with the OnSelectMission voice type and passed to character select. Exported values are 300 for CHAP_0001..CHAP_0007 and CHAP_0009, and 301 for CHAP_0008; rows 300/301 contain one/two non-None voices with equal positive weights.

Id_PlayVoice_OnSelectMission.simple: The voice played when the player chooses a story mission. DLC chapters use their own voice.
Id_PlayVoice_OnSelectMission.technical: FName (row +0x58). Story_GetChapterSelectVoiceType_1307CA0 finds the PlayVoice row and returns its PlayVoiceType as uint8, or 0xFF when the chapter/row is missing; UGameStoryMissionSelectWidget::OnMissionDecided plays that type with the chapter's rolled PickIndex when it is not 0xFF. The export uses 310 for all chapters except CHAP_0008, which uses the DLC1 variant 311.

Id_PlayVoice_StartDialog.simple: The voice used as the player moves into character selection for the story. DLC chapters use their own voice here.
Id_PlayVoice_StartDialog.technical: FName (row +0x60). BuildChapterVoicePicks resolves it to SelectVoice. On the character-select transition MainMenuStory copies SelectVoice->Id (the PlayVoice table row key, not one of that row's Id_Voice entries) into StudioStoryRequestName_CEC and copies the chapter's rolled PickIndex into StudioStoryRequestInt48_CF4. The export uses 330 for CHAP_0001..CHAP_0007 and CHAP_0009, and the DLC1 variant 331 for CHAP_0008.

Id_StoryDemo.simple: The story missions that belong to this chapter, in play order. The game uses them to track progress, unlock missions, and resume play.
Id_StoryDemo.technical: TArray<FName> (row +0x68) with 20 exported slots; None slots are padding. The exported lists are chapter-ordered and partition all 115 StoryDemo rows exactly once. Consumers use membership for demo-to-chapter reverse lookup and progress-flag tests, iterate non-None entries for cleared percentage (0..100 truncated; 100 when empty) and objective counts (objective 0 = demo state >=2, objectives 1..2 need a task detail id and task flag >=1), available/resume-demo selection, room-condition selection, chapter lock/unstarted tests and ShowTitle lookup. Main-demo tests use the demo row id ending in M case-insensitively; CHAP_0007 entries are treated as main in several availability/clear checks. Story_GetChapterFirstDemo returns Id_StoryDemo.GetData()[0] without a length check; all exported rows are non-empty.

notes: Checkpoint placement uses ChapterIndex 6, which is CHAP_0006 in the export. If that chapter has a pending main demo (state < 2), Story_PickRoomPlacement falls back to the last cleared demo's non-None Id_StoryRoomCondition over all chapters, starting from ROOM_COND_0000; with bPickWhenAllCleared=false it instead returns the saved StudioStoryRoomPlacementId_D18, and with true it picks uniformly from all non-None demo conditions. The chosen condition then supplies a weighted placement. The code's extra CHAP_0007 branch is not reached with these exports because the selected checkpoint row is CHAP_0006 (Source/Abrams/Private/StoryLaunchHelpers.cpp:211-323).

The row constructor sets only ChapterIndex to 0; Id and the other FName members default to NAME_None, and both TArray members default to empty (Source/AbramsDataTable/Private/GameDataTableRow_StoryChapter.cpp:3).

The manager resolves one StoryChapterDataTable primary asset into one StoryChapterDataTables array; FGameDataTableArray::GetRows re-enumerates row names and calls FindRow on each pass. No numbered shard, alias array, duplicate loader or persistent row cache appears in the reconstructed manager. Transient per-phase maps (BGM, voice picks, release missions, movie files) are keyed by Chapter.Id (Source/Abrams/Private/GameDataTableManager.cpp:269, Source/Abrams/Public/GameDataTableArray.h:14).

Story_GetProgressFlagChapters_1302FC0 is misleadingly named: its matched RemoveAll predicate drops rows whose first flag is not -1 and retains the -1 (base-story) rows. Shop completion/objective unlock cases consume those base-story rows; DLC chapter lists instead use MissionSelect_HasProgressFlag (Source/Abrams/Private/StoryLaunchHelpers.cpp:811-825, Source/Abrams/Private/GameShopSaleItemListItemDataBase.cpp:543-581, Source/Abrams/Private/GamePhase_MainMenuStory.cpp:1243-1257).

Export relationships checked: nine unique chapter rows and no locale variants or shards; all nine title ids occur in every exported StoryTextDataTable locale; all 115 non-None Id_StoryDemo entries resolve to StoryDemo rows with no duplicates; the two BGM ids resolve in BgmDataTable; the six distinct PlayVoice ids resolve in PlayVoiceDataTable; and flags 6/7 match DLC07/DLC08 in the reconstructed entitlement map.

Behavioral statements here are from statically analysed reconstructed C++ plus exported data. No retail Blueprint evidence was inspected, and the exports do not prove that referenced texture/movie assets exist or contain the expected content.

usages.detail: Resolves the StoryChapterDataTable primary asset and appends it to StoryChapterDataTables; the name is also registered at line 442.
GetRows collects rows from every table in row-name order; StoryFindRowOutOfLine scans the same array and can reject NAME_None when bCheckNone is set (StoryLaunchHelpers.cpp:118-131).
Story_GetProgressFlagChapters_1302FC0 retains chapters whose first UserProgressFlag is -1 (base story); shop completion and objective unlock cases consume this collection.
MissionSelect_HasProgressFlag reports true only when the re-found chapter row's first flag exists and is not -1; it partitions chapter pagination and DLC chapter lists.
MainMenuStory_IsChapterLocked decodes that flag into a UserProgressFlagWords word/bit; an absent/-1 flag is unlocked, word >= 128 is locked, and an unset bit is locked.
Computes a truncated 0..100 cleared percentage (100 for an empty list) and cleared/total objective counts over a chapter's non-None demos.
Finds the first uncleared demo whose row id ends in M; used for resume selection and first-pending-demo scans.
Story_PickRoomPlacement selects ChapterIndex 6 and derives room conditions from its pending main demos, all chapter demo lists and the saved placement.
Story_GetChapterIdForDemo and MainMenuStory_GetDemoChapterId reverse-map a demo membership to the first chapter row; Story_GetDemoChapterIndex returns the corresponding ChapterIndex or -1.
Available demo lists skip locked chapters and demos whose state is nonzero or whose non-None child demos are not cleared; credits and post-battle phases aggregate these lists for every chapter.
Collects chapter BGM rows and zero-initialised resume positions into ChapterBgmIds/BgmResumes; PlayChapterBgm consumes those maps.
Builds chapter voice picks from the Open/StartDialog PlayVoice rows and rolls PickIndex from the OpenVoice weights.
Resolves Id_PlayVoice_OnSelectMission to a PlayVoiceType (0xFF on a miss) for OnMissionDecided's system voice.
Sends Id_PlayVoice_StartDialog's PlayVoice row key and the chapter's PickIndex to GameManager for StoryCharacterSelect.
DLC purchase flow matches the chapter's first progress flag to the reconstructed entitlement map and opens that store page.
Creates WidgetTexture loaders from the chapter's full-size thumbnail; the panel resolves the loader and the chapter image uses ReplacementTexture.
Creates WidgetTexture loaders from SmallThumbnailFileName for normal and DLC chapter-select cards.
Builds the DLC background .usm map from non-None BackgroundMovieFileName values, keyed by Chapter.Id.
ShowTitle reverse-maps the current demo to its chapter and passes the chapter title and ChapterIndex to StoryDemoWidget.
Collection archive movie items reverse-map their demo to a chapter and render ChapterIndex as INDEX.
Chapter names in shop sale-item descriptions come from Id_StoryChapterTitle, with ERROR only for a missing row.
